arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "Destination") AS n_destinations, COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date")) AS n_months, MIN("Date") AS min_date, MAX("Date") AS max_date FROM "sheet1"
SELECT "Destination", COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS total_profit, ROUND(AVG("Profit"),2) AS avg_profit FROM "sheet1" GROUP BY "Destination" ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT "Destination", COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS total_profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY "Destination" ORDER BY orders DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM("List Price Revenue"),2) AS list_rev, ROUND(SUM("Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue"),2) AS vas_rev, ROUND(SUM("Discount Amount"),2) AS discount, ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Revenue"),2) AS total_rev, ROUND(SUM("Freight Cost"),2) AS freight_cost, ROUND(SUM("Warehousing Cost"),2) AS warehousing_cost, ROUND(SUM("Other Operating Costs"),2) AS other_cost, ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Cost"),2) AS total_cost, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") ORDER BY month

SELECT "Consigned Product" AS product, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty, ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Revenue"),2) AS rev, ROUND(SUM("Freight Cost"),2) AS freight, ROUND(SUM("Warehousing Cost"),2) AS wh, ROUND(SUM("Other Operating Costs"),2) AS other, ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Cost"),2) AS cost, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY "Consigned Product" ORDER BY profit DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, "Consigned Product" AS product, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month, "Consigned Product" ORDER BY month, profit DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, substr("Destination", 1, instr("Destination", '-') - 1) AS region, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" GROUP BY month, region ORDER BY region, month

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, "Destination" AS city, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month, "Destination" ORDER BY month, profit DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, "Consigned Product" AS product, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty, ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Revenue"),2) AS rev, ROUND(SUM("Total Logistics Cost"),2) AS cost, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month, "Consigned Product" ORDER BY month, product

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM("Sales Quantity") AS qty, ROUND(AVG("Logistics Unit Price"),2) AS avg_unit_price, ROUND(SUM("List Price Revenue"),2) AS list_rev, ROUND(SUM("Logistics Value-Added Service Revenue"),2) AS vas_rev, ROUND(SUM("Discount Amount"),2) AS discount FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, "Age Range" AS age_range, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month, "Age Range" ORDER BY month, profit DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, "Customer Gender" AS gender, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM("Profit"),2) AS profit FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month, "Customer Gender" ORDER BY month, profit DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS month, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Guangdong%' OR "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Guangxi%' OR "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Hainan%' THEN "Profit" ELSE 0 END),2) AS core_gd_gx_hn_profit, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Henan%' OR "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Hubei%' OR "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Hunan%' THEN "Profit" ELSE 0 END),2) AS central_cities_profit, SUM(CASE WHEN "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Guangdong%' OR "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Guangxi%' OR "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Hainan%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS core_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Henan%' OR "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Hubei%' OR "Destination" LIKE 'South China-Hunan%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS central_orders FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

timing_note: Serial MCP service start/end boundaries from request/completion logs; original overlapping client timestamps retained. Queue residence is not an idle optimization window. Measures sequential database service, not sum of overlapping client call durations.
